title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Training Notes — Auto Maintenance Cashback for Heavy-Order Shoppers at Card Exit
content:
**The rule.** In the cashback settlement made when a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, auto maintenance cashback is boosted for heavy-order shoppers: a shopper with 6 or more batch heavy-pay entries in the last month has the month's auto maintenance cashback multiplied by 1.5, a shopper with 3 to 5 has it multiplied by 1.2, and any other shopper keeps it as earned. The boosted auto maintenance figure is rounded to the cent before the cap is applied.

### Questions this rule answers

**Which entries count?** The batch pay entries for heavy pay posted on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Batches records, booked fewer than 1 whole month before the day of the move ("the last month").

**Which cashback is boosted?** The auto maintenance cashback earned for the statement month the settlement carries. Fuel and EV charging cashback are not touched by this rule.

**When is the boosted figure rounded?** Once, to the cent, as soon as it is multiplied — before the cap is applied.

**What happens with 2 heavy-pay entries?** No boost; the auto maintenance cashback enters as earned.

| Heavy-pay entries in the last month | Multiplier on auto maintenance cashback |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.5 |
| 3 to 5 | 1.2 |
| 2 or fewer | none, as earned |

### Worked cases (hypothetical inputs, auto maintenance cashback earned 4.35)

- 6 heavy-pay entries: 4.35 multiplied by 1.5 is 6.525, rounded to the cent 6.53.
- 5 heavy-pay entries: 4.35 multiplied by 1.2 is 5.22.
- 3 heavy-pay entries: 5.22, as in the line above.
- 2 heavy-pay entries: 4.35.
